title: Singmaster's Conjecture
exact_target: Is there one finite bound on how many times any entry greater than one can appear in the whole Pascal triangle?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 1495 (NUM-001). CC BY 4.0.

Kaisa Matom\"aki, Maksym Radziwi\l\l, Xuancheng Shao, Terence Tao and Joni Ter\"av\"ainen, \emph{Singmaster's conjecture in the interior of Pascal's triangle}, Quarterly Journal of Mathematics 73 (2022), 1137--1177; arXiv:2106.03335, Section 1, Conjecture 1.1 and (1.1).
